templates.statBuff: Temporarily increase {stat} by {percent}% per stack. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Lose {decrease} stack at the start of the user's turn.
templates.statDebuff: Temporarily reduce {stat} by {percent}% per stack. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Lose {decrease} stack at the end of the user's turn.
templates.protect: Block damage from direct attack. (Max {maxPercent}% of MaxHP, {upgradeMaxPercent}% if upgraded)
templates.stackGuard: Reduce direct damage received by {basePercent}% ({upgradePercent}% if upgraded) for one hit. Becomes {decayPercent}% less effective after each hit.
templates.secondChance: Prevent lethal damage once per stack and recover {recoverPercent}% of MaxHP when triggered. Max {max} stacks.
templates.guard: Reduce one action's direct damage received by {basePercent}% ({upgradePercent}% if upgraded). Consumed on activation. [End-of-Turn] passives will also consume this buff.
templates.instinct: For every direct instance of damage you take, gain a stacking buff. For each stack, reduce direct damage received by {perStackPercent}%. Removed at the start of turn. Damage reduction caps at {baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}% if you have {threshold} or more {name} stacks.
templates.rage: For every instance of damage dealt to the enemy, gain a stacking buff. For each stack, boost damage dealt by {perStackPercent}%. Removed at the end of turn. Damage boost caps at {baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}% if you have {threshold} or more {name} stacks.
templates.statBoost: Boost this stat by {percent}% for each stack (Max {max} stacks).
templates.vriStrength: Suffer {percent}% damage based on target's Strength for each stack at the start and end of each turn. Suffer the received stacks' damage instantly if gained during the user's turn. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Lose half of the stacks at the end of turn)
templates.vriAgility: Suffer {percent}% damage based on target's Agility for each stack at the start and end of each turn. Suffer the received stacks' damage instantly if gained during the user's turn. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Lose half of the stacks at the end of turn)
templates.vriIntelligence: Suffer {percent}% damage based on target's Intelligence for each stack at the start and end of each turn. Suffer the received stacks' damage instantly if gained during the user's turn. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Lose half of the stacks at the end of turn)
templates.confuse: Next action's attack, heal and Protect skills will use a random attribute (not including Max HP) as multiplier instead of the one they originally have. Actions become unpredictable. (Max {max} stacks. Remove 1 stack on trigger, won't affect stat combo)
templates.elementActionBuff: Buff one action's {element} damage and heal by {percent}% for each stack. (Max {max}/upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Consumed on activation. [End-of-Turn] passives will also consume this buff)
templates.elementalDamage: Consume all {element} elements. For each stack consumed, deal {percent}% {element} damage based on your strongest attribute. If the specific condition is met, trigger {finale}.
templates.statusBurn: For each stack, take {percent}% damage based on MaxHP at the start of turn and receive more damage from {element} attacks. Suffer the received stacks' damage instantly if gained during the user's turn. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of each turn).
templates.statusChill: With {threshold} or more stacks, decrease Action Point by {apReduction} at the start of turn (Enemy AP will not go below {enemyMinimumAP}) and receive more damage from {element} attacks. Reduce AP instantly if gained during user's turn. With {sealAt} stacks, seal [{sealedTiming}] passives. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Remove at the end of each turn).
templates.statusParalysis: {percent}% chance that executing an action will fail for each stack and receive more damage from {element} attacks. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of turn).
templates.statusSeed: Receive more damage from {element} attacks and the opponent heals for {percent}% of the damage they deal for each stack. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of turn).
templates.statusDizzy: For each stack, {percent}% chance that using a buff or debuff skill (excluding {excluded}) will be used on the wrong target, and receive more damage from {element} attacks. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of turn).
templates.statusBlind: Attacks have {percent}% chance to miss for each stack and receive more damage from {element} attacks. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of turn).
templates.statusDepress: Healing and Protect gain are decreased by {percent}% for each stack, and receive more damage from {element} attacks. (Max {max} / upgrade {upgradeMax} stacks. Removed at the end of turn).
templates.elementCore: For each {element} element stack on self, increase non-elemental damage dealt to opponents with {status} or {counters} element by {damageBonus}% and reduce {element} and {counters} elemental damage received by {reduction}% per stack. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Lose {loseStacks} stack when hit by a {counteredBy} attack.
templates.elementAbilityCore: Increase damage dealt and healing by {stackBonus}% for each {element} element on self. If the opponent has {counters} element or {status}, increase damage dealt by {conditionalBonus}%, or {upgradedConditionalBonus}% when upgraded.
templates.elementFinale: If an elemental attack consumes {threshold} or more {element} element stacks, deal an extra {damage}% {element} damage based on your strongest attribute. If {maxThreshold} stacks are consumed, deal {maxDamage}% instead.
templates.elementVulnerable: Receive {percent}% more damage from {element} attacks for each stack. {secondary} Max {max} stacks. Removed at the end of turn.

templates.protect: 抵挡一定数值的直接攻击伤害。 (上限为MaxHP的{maxPercent}%, 升级后提升至{upgradeMaxPercent}% )
templates.stackGuard: 下一击承受的直接伤害减轻{basePercent}%(升级后{upgradePercent}% )。每次发动后伤害减轻效果将会降低{decayPercent}%。
templates.guard: 降低{basePercent}%敌方（或自己）一个行动对自身所造成的直接伤害。 (升级了提升至{upgradePercent}%。发动后才消耗。【回合结束】的被动技能也会消耗此效果)
templates.instinct: 每当你受到直接伤害时, 获得并叠加此增益效果：每叠加减低自身{perStackPercent}%所受到的伤害。(回合开始时去除。伤害减低可达到{baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}%如果{name}的叠加数等于或超过{threshold} )
templates.rage: 每当你攻击时, 获得并叠加此增益效果：每叠加提升自身{perStackPercent}%对敌方造成的伤害。(回合结束时去除。伤害提升可达到{baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}%如果{name}的叠加数等于或超过{threshold} )
templates.statBoost: 每层使此属性增加{percent}%。(叠加上限{max} )
templates.vriStrength: 每个回合开始和结束时, 根据自身的力量对自己造成{percent}%的伤害。如果在自身回合获得此效果, 自身将直接受到所获得的效果伤害。(叠加上限{max} / 升级后{upgradeMax}。回合结束后失去一半的叠加数)
templates.vriAgility: 每个回合开始和结束时, 根据自身的敏捷对自己造成{percent}%的伤害。如果在自身回合获得此效果, 自身将直接受到所获得的效果伤害。(叠加上限{max} / 升级后{upgradeMax}。回合结束后失去一半的叠加数)
templates.vriIntelligence: 每个回合开始和结束时, 根据自身的智力对自己造成{percent}%的伤害。如果在自身回合获得此效果, 自身将直接受到所获得的效果伤害。(叠加上限{max} / 升级后{upgradeMax}。回合结束后失去一半的叠加数)
templates.confuse: 下个行动将使用随机的属性值(不包括Max HP)来计算伤害, 恢复与护甲获得量。行动变得无法预料。(叠加上限{max}。触发时失去1叠加数, 不会影响属性值连击)
templates.elementActionBuff: 增强{percent}%一个行动的{element}元素伤害和恢复。(叠加上限{max} / 升级后{upgradeMax}。发动后消耗, 【回合结束】的被动技能也会消耗此效果)

templates.protect: 抵擋一定數值的直接攻擊傷害。 (上限為MaxHP的{maxPercent}%, 升級後提升至{upgradeMaxPercent}% )
templates.stackGuard: 下一擊承受的直接傷害減輕{basePercent}%(升級後{upgradePercent}% )。每次發動後伤害减轻效果將會降低{decayPercent}%。
templates.guard: 降低{basePercent}%敵方（或自己）一個行動對自身所造成的直接傷害。 (升級了提升至{upgradePercent}%。發動後才消耗。【回合结束】的被動技能也會消耗此效果)
templates.instinct: 每當你受到直接傷害時, 獲得並疊加此增益效果：每疊加減低自身{perStackPercent}%所受到的傷害。(回合開始時去除。傷害減低可達到{baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}%如果{name}的疊加數等於或超過{threshold} )
templates.rage: 每當你攻擊時, 獲得並疊加此增益效果：每疊加提升自身{perStackPercent}%對敵方造成的傷害。(回合结束時去除。傷害提升可達到{baseCapPercent}% / {enhancedCapPercent}%如果{name}的疊加數等於或超過{threshold} )
templates.statBoost: 每層使此屬性增加{percent}%。 (疊加上限{max} )
templates.vriStrength: 每個回合開始和结束時, 根據自身的力量對自己造成{percent}%的傷害。如果在自身回合獲得此效果, 自身將直接受到所獲得的效果傷害。 (疊加上限{max} / 升級後{upgradeMax}。回合结束後失去一半的疊加數)
templates.vriAgility: 每個回合開始和结束時, 根據自身的敏捷對自己造成{percent}%的傷害。如果在自身回合獲得此效果, 自身將直接受到所獲得的效果傷害。 (疊加上限{max} / 升級後{upgradeMax}。回合结束後失去一半的疊加數)
templates.vriIntelligence: 每個回合開始和结束時, 根據自身的智力對自己造成{percent}%的傷害。如果在自身回合獲得此效果, 自身將直接受到所獲得的效果傷害。 (疊加上限{max} / 升級後{upgradeMax}。回合结束後失去一半的疊加數)
templates.confuse: 下個行動將使用隨機的屬性值(不包括Max HP)來計算傷害, 恢復與護甲獲得量。行動變得無法預料。(疊加上限{max}。觸發時失去1疊加數, 不會影響屬性值連擊)
templates.elementActionBuff: 增強{percent}%一個行動的{element}元素傷害和恢復。 (疊加上限{max} / 升級後{upgradeMax}。發動後消耗, 【回合结束】的被動技能也會消耗此效果)
